invariants.text: Book.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Member.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Loan.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Loan.book_id must reference an existing Book.id
Loan.member_id must reference an existing Member.id
A book can have at most one active loan at any time.
When a loan is closed, the book's available status is updated to true.
A loan is considered active if its is_active field is true.
A member can have multiple loans, each associated with a different book.
A loan must be associated with a book and a member.
The due_date of a loan is calculated as the loan_date plus a fixed period (e.g., 14 days), unless overridden by policy.
If a book is currently loaned out, it is not considered available.
Closing a loan requires that the loan is active and not already closed.
A book's available status is determined by whether it has an active loan or not.
Each loan must have a unique id and be linked to exactly one book and one member.
